how_to_apply: Visit the official NATS website at nats.education.gov.in.
Complete NATS registration if not already registered.
Log in and locate the LIC Housing Finance Limited apprenticeship advertisement for Program-010.
Read the eligibility conditions, training locations and application instructions.
Apply for the eligible LIC HFL apprenticeship opportunity.
Save the NATS Enrolment ID for future correspondence.
Check the registered email account for communication from BFSI SSC at [email protected].
Follow the email instructions and open the BFSI SSC BEEP portal to provide additional application details and training location preferences.
Pay the applicable application/examination fee online by 1 November 2026.
Ensure that the details entered during examination registration match the NATS registration information.
Check the registered email for examination instructions and login details before the 7 November 2026 examination.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have completed graduation in any stream from a university or institute recognized by UGC/AICTE and satisfy the age and previous apprenticeship restrictions. Important: The notification expressly states that candidates must have completed graduation by 1 October 2026 and must not have a running, terminated or completed apprenticeship contract with another organization.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must be between 20 and 25 years of age as on 1 October 2026 .

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Stipend 2026
content_sections.text: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 16,650 in specified metro cities and Rs. 14,150 in other cities during the 12-month apprenticeship training. The higher stipend applies to training positions in Ahmedabad, Bangalore, Chennai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune and Surat . Apprentices engaged in other notified cities will receive Rs. 14,150 per month. Note: These are apprenticeship stipends, not salaries for regular LIC Housing Finance Limited employees.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: Successful apprentices will receive a proficiency certificate from the Board of Apprenticeship Training (BOAT). They may contact BFSI SSC regarding available placement opportunities after completing the programme, but LIC HFL is not obligated to provide permanent employment.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will include an online remote-proctored entrance examination, followed by document verification and a personal interview for shortlisted candidates. NATS Registration: Eligible graduates must register and apply for the LIC HFL apprenticeship opportunity through NATS. BFSI SSC Examination Registration: Eligible applicants receive an email requesting additional application details, training location preferences and fee payment. Online Entrance Examination: Candidates who complete the examination registration and fee payment appear in the remote-proctored test. Document Verification and Personal Interview: Candidates shortlisted on the basis of the entrance examination are invited to LIC HFL offices. Final Engagement: Selected candidates receive an engagement letter mentioning the training branch, stipend and apprenticeship conditions.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The entrance examination will be conducted by BFSI Sector Skill Council of India on 7 November 2026 . It contains 100 objective questions carrying 100 marks, with a total duration of 60 minutes. The examination must be taken remotely from the candidate's residence. Candidates require a suitable camera-enabled desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone with a reliable internet connection. Candidates must remain isolated from other people during the examination, except where approved accommodations apply. Aadhaar Card must be displayed for identity verification as instructed by the examination authority. BFSI SSC will communicate the examination link and login credentials one day before the examination. Further examination instructions will be provided through the official information handout. Important: Candidates must complete the separate BFSI SSC examination registration. Failure to register for the written test will lead to disqualification from further participation.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible graduates must apply for LIC HFL Apprenticeship Program-010 through the official National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal between 20 October and 1 November 2026. Apply Online / NATS Registration: LIC HFL Graduate Apprentice Application Portal BFSI SSC Examination Registration and Fee Payment: BFSI SSC BEEP Portal Last Date: 1 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Aadhaar Card used for NATS registration and examination identity verification. Graduation degree certificate and relevant marksheets. Proof of date of birth. NATS Enrolment ID and registration details. Category or PwBD certificate, if claiming the applicable examination fee concession. Application/examination fee payment confirmation. Other documents requested by BFSI SSC or LIC HFL during document verification.

content_sections.heading: LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Document Verification and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates shortlisted based on the entrance examination result will be invited for document verification and a personal interview at LIC Housing Finance Limited offices on 15 November 2026 , according to the notified schedule. The selection authority will communicate the applicable interview and verification details to shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: LIC Housing Finance Limited has announced 232 Graduate Apprentice training positions at its offices across India.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply through NATS is 1 November 2026. The separate BFSI SSC examination registration and fee payment must also be completed by the same date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed graduation in any stream from a UGC/AICTE-recognized university or institute and satisfy the remaining eligibility conditions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applicants must be between 20 and 25 years of age as on 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the monthly stipend for LIC HFL Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected apprentices will receive Rs. 16,650 per month in specified metro cities and Rs. 14,150 per month in other cities.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 200 plus GST for SC/ST/PwBD candidates, Rs. 800 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC male candidates, and Rs. 600 plus GST for General/EWS/OBC female and transgender candidates.

faq.question: Q7. When will the LIC HFL Apprentice Entrance Exam 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The remote-proctored online entrance examination is scheduled for 7 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for LIC HFL Apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection includes an online entrance examination followed by document verification and personal interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Is NATS registration mandatory for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must register through NATS and apply for the LIC HFL apprenticeship advertisement before completing the separate BFSI SSC examination registration and fee payment.

faq.question: Q10. Does LIC HFL provide permanent jobs after apprenticeship?
faq.answer: No. LIC HFL states that the 12-month programme is apprenticeship training and that it is not obligated to offer full-time employment after completion.
